title: Sync between devices
description: Your data, end-to-end encrypted, kept in step between your devices.

status.unreachableNote: Sync resumes once the server is in reach.

problem.captureBroken: This device's change tracking is damaged, so syncing stopped. It can be repaired.
problem.vaultGone: The synced data was deleted from the sync server.
problem.lapsed: The subscription has ended, so syncing is paused.
problem.quotaExceeded: The synced data is over the storage limit.
problem.snapshotTooLarge: The data is too large to sync.
problem.newerSchema: Another device uses a newer version of Moony. Update this app to continue.
problem.gap: A change from another device hasn't arrived yet. This device keeps syncing and sending its own changes.
problem.clockAhead: A change from another device is dated more than ten years ahead, so it is held. It stays held even after that device's clock is corrected; you can skip it after 14 days.
problem.undecryptable: Changes from another device could not be decrypted.
problem.invalidChain: Changes from another device failed verification and are held.
problem.missingParent: Changes from another device are missing earlier steps and are held.
problem.quarantined: Changes from some devices are held for safety.
problem.offline: No connection to the sync server. Syncing resumes when it is back.
problem.relayError: The sync server is not answering as expected. Moony keeps trying.
problem.rateLimited: The sync server asked Moony to slow down. Moony will try again soon.
problem.unauthorized: The sync server did not accept this device. Setting up sync again may be needed.
problem.keyRotated: The recovery key was changed on another device. Set up sync on this device again.
problem.secureStorage: Moony could not reach this device's secure storage, so syncing is paused. It will try again; unlocking the device or restarting Moony usually helps.
problem.serverWentBack: The sync server went back to an older state, so changes may be missing on your other devices. Your data on this device is intact. Moony cannot repair this on its own yet: to bring your devices back together, turn sync off, set it up again on the device with the most complete data, and join the others. Don't re-sync: it would replace this device's data with the sync server's older copy. Setting sync up again creates a new sync account.
problem.internal: Syncing stopped because of an internal error.

status.clockAhead: This device's clock was ahead at some point (or that of a device it synced with), so its changes are dated {{date}} until then. They still sync; if the same item is edited on another device, this device's version wins until that date.

server.label: Sync server
server.dialogBody: Use this when your sync server moved to a new address. It must be the same server, with your synced data. Every device changes its own address, so do the same on your other devices. Save the Recovery Kit again: it now carries the new address.
server.unchanged: This device already uses this address.
server.repeatOnOthers: Do the same on your other devices.

intro.description: Keep your data, documents and photos included, in step on all your devices. It is end-to-end encrypted: the sync server only stores data it cannot read.
intro.privacy: Your data never leaves your devices unencrypted.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel the setup?
cancelConfirm.description: This device forgets the sync account created for this setup, and a payment already made for it is not carried over. Setting up sync again starts from the start, with a new sync account.

intro.startLead: This device will be the first. You need your sync server's connection code.
intro.joinLead: You already sync on another device.

account.description: Sync needs a sync account. Create one to get its number.
account.explain: This number is your sync account. Anyone who has it can pay for it and see whether it is paid. It does not open your data.

pay.description: Choose a plan. Payment opens in your browser.
pay.waiting: Waiting for the payment. This window moves on when it arrives.
pay.ownServer: This server is not the Moony cloud, so there is nothing to pay. Set sync up with the connection code of your own sync server instead.

kit.description: Save your Sync Recovery Kit. It is the only way to get your synced data back if you lose all your devices.
kit.clipboardHint: Clear your clipboard after pasting the code.
kit.confirm: I saved my Sync Recovery Kit
kit.differs: The Sync Recovery Kit is not your device's recovery key. They are different, and you need both.
kit.saveFirst: Save or copy the kit first.

file.title: Moony Sync Recovery Kit
file.intro: Keep this page somewhere safe, away from your devices. Anyone who has it can read your synced data.
file.accountNote: Identifies your sync account. It does not open your data.
file.codeNote: Opens your synced data. Keep it secret.
file.qrLabel: Scan to restore on a phone
file.relayNote: Needed to restore from this kit

kit.folderWarning: Keep the Kit on paper or in a password manager, not in a folder that syncs to a cloud service.
kit.syncedFolder: Kit saved, but this folder looks like it syncs to a cloud service. Move the file somewhere that does not sync, or delete it once the Kit is on paper.
kit.saveRefused: This Kit is out of date, so it was not saved. Close it and show the Kit again.

device.description: Name this device so you can tell it apart from your others.
device.name: Device name

server.title: Where should your data sync?
server.cloudHint: Nothing to install, we run it.
server.codeHint: You get it from whoever runs your sync server.
server.insecureBody: Your data stays encrypted, but anyone on the same network can capture the access to sync and delete or block the synced data on the server.

lapsed.title: Sync paused — renew to continue
lapsed.deletes: Synced data will be deleted on {{date}}.
lapsed.selfHosted: Your account is blocked on your sync server. Ask whoever runs it to unblock it.

vaultGone.text: Your synced data is gone from the server. Turn sync off on this device?

alert.newerSchema: Update Moony on this device to keep syncing

gap.missing_one: A change from “{{device}}” has been missing for {{days}} days.
gap.missing_other: {{count}} changes from “{{device}}” have been missing for {{days}} days.
gap.waiting: A change from “{{device}}” has waited {{days}} days for an earlier change it depends on, which never arrived.
gap.skipFrom: If it still hasn't arrived by {{date}}, you can skip it then.

clockAhead.text: A change from “{{device}}” is dated {{date}}, more than ten years ahead, so it is held. It stays held even after that device's clock is corrected.
clockAhead.textFar: A change from “{{device}}” is dated far in the future, more than ten years ahead, so it is held. It stays held even after that device's clock is corrected.

repair.title: Repair this device?
repair.description: Moony saves a backup of this device's data, sends the changes still waiting, and then replaces this device's data with the synced data. If the changes cannot all be sent, nothing is replaced.

resync.hint: Replaces this device's data with the synced data, after saving a backup. Use it only if this device cannot sync any other way.
resync.title: Re-sync this device?
resync.description: This device's data is replaced with the synced data. A backup is saved first.

skipGap.description_one: The change from “{{device}}” that never arrived will be skipped. It comes back on this device only if a device that has it uploads a newer copy of the synced data; if no device has it, it is lost. Changes that depend on it may need to be skipped too.
skipGap.description_other: The {{count}} changes from “{{device}}” that never arrived will be skipped. They come back on this device only if a device that has them uploads a newer copy of the synced data; if no device has them, they are lost. Changes that depend on them may need to be skipped too.
skipGap.descriptionParent: The change from “{{device}}” that cannot be applied will be skipped. What it held comes back on this device only if a device that applied it uploads a newer copy of the synced data; if none did, it is lost. Changes that depend on it may need to be skipped too.
skipGap.success_one: The missing change was skipped. Syncing continues.
skipGap.success_other: The missing changes were skipped. Syncing continues.
skipGap.arrived: The missing change arrived in the meantime; nothing was skipped.
skipGap.titleAhead: Skip the change dated in the future?
skipGap.descriptionAhead: The change from “{{device}}” dated {{date}} will be skipped, and that device's later changes will sync. It comes back on this device only if a device that applied it uploads a newer copy of the synced data; if none did, it is lost.
skipGap.descriptionAheadFar: The change from “{{device}}” dated far in the future will be skipped, and that device's later changes will sync. It comes back on this device only if a device that applied it uploads a newer copy of the synced data; if none did, it is lost.
skipGap.successAhead: The change was skipped. Syncing continues.
skipGap.appliedAhead: The change was applied in the meantime; nothing was skipped.

turnOff.button: Turn off sync on this device
turnOff.hint: Local data stays. Other devices keep syncing.
turnOff.title: Turn off sync on this device?
turnOff.description: Local data stays. Other devices keep syncing. You can join again later by pairing with another device or with your Recovery Kit; this device's data is then replaced by the synced data after a backup.
turnOff.pendingChanges_one: {{count}} change on this device has not been sent yet. It will not be sent.
turnOff.pendingChanges_other: {{count}} changes on this device have not been sent yet. They will not be sent.
turnOff.noCutOff: Turning sync off here doesn't cut off any other device or Kit.

delete.hint: Removes the synced data from the sync server for every device.
delete.title: Delete synced data?
delete.description: This deletes the synced data on the sync server for every device. The local data on every device stays.
delete.afterwards: Afterwards sync is set up from the start, with a new sync account and a new Recovery Kit.
delete.afterwardsOwnServer: Afterwards you can set sync up again with the same connection code and a new Recovery Kit.

danger.title: Turn off or delete
danger.description: Stop syncing on this device, or delete what the sync server stores.

leftover.text: This profile has device sync turned on from a development build. Its changes are still recorded for sync.
leftover.noServer: The synced data and the sync account stay on the sync server until they are deleted from a version of Moony that has sync.
leftover.description: Local data stays. Other devices keep syncing. Joining again later needs a version of Moony that has sync.
leftover.phoneDescription: Local data on this phone stays. Your other devices keep syncing. Joining again later needs a version of Moony that has sync.

showKit.title: Sync Recovery Kit
showKit.description: Enter your device password to show the kit.
showKit.again: Enter your password again to show the kit.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The devices that sync with this account.
devices.quiet_one: No changes from this device in {{count}} day
devices.quiet_other: No changes from this device in {{count}} days

pairing.addDescription: Pair another device with your sync account. Nothing leaves your devices unencrypted.
pairing.passwordFirst: Enter your device password to show the pairing code.
pairing.scanHint: Scan this with Moony on your phone: Settings → Sync → Scan a code
pairing.typePrompt: Type the six digits shown on your other device
pairing.showPrompt: Type this code on your other device. Continue here once it says the code is right.
pairing.notStartedWarning: If you did not start this pairing, cancel.
pairing.contested: Another device answered this code first, so this pairing cannot go on. Cancel here and start again on both devices.
pairing.sent: Sent. Finish on the other device.
pairing.joined: This device now syncs. Its earlier data is backed up in {{path}}
pairing.readyToJoin: The sync details arrived. Check what is replaced, then join.

join.warning: This device's data is replaced by the synced data. A backup is saved next to your profile first.
join.serverHint: Type the address of your sync server, or paste its connection code.
join.insecureAtJoin: The sync details you are joining with point to {{host}}, which is reached over plain http. Your data stays encrypted, but anyone on the same network can capture the access to sync and delete or block the synced data on the server.
join.pairHint: On the phone with sync on: Settings → Sync → Add a device
join.kitHint: Enter the recovery code from your Sync Recovery Kit, or the text of its QR code.

pair.title: I have a phone that syncs
pair.lead: A code appears. On the phone: Settings → Sync → Add a device.

kit.title: I have the Sync Recovery Kit
kit.lead: You enter the code from the kit and the server address. This is also how a second computer joins.

phone.title: Sync

scan.title: Scan a code from the computer
scan.lead: On the computer: Settings → Sync → Add a device. The scanner also takes a Recovery Kit QR.

phone.busy: Keep Moony open until it is done.
phone.turnOffBody: Local data on this phone stays. Your other devices keep syncing. To join again later, pair with another device or type your Recovery Kit code; this phone's data is then replaced by the synced data after a backup.
phone.renewUnavailable: Renewing isn't available in the phone app.
phone.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on your other device (Settings → Sync → Add a device) or at the QR code of your Recovery Kit.
phone.addDeviceHint: On the new device, choose “Connect this device” in Settings → Sync, then point the camera at the code it shows.
phone.passwordFirst: Enter your device password before you scan the other device's code.
phone.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to scan the code.
phone.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not be opened.
phone.unknownCode: This QR code is not a Moony pairing code or Recovery Kit.
phone.kitConfirmBody: This phone's data is replaced by the synced data (a backup is kept).
phone.notAKitCode: This is not a Recovery Kit code
phone.notAPairingCode: This is not a pairing code.
phone.devPasteTitle: Paste a pairing code — developer tool
phone.notAConnectionCode: This QR code is not a connection code for a sync server.
phone.scanConnectionHint: Point the camera at the connection code of your sync server.

lines.items: Changed items waiting to be sent: {{count}}
lines.batches: Batches of changes not yet confirmed by the sync server: {{count}}

replace.attachments: Afterwards, the documents and photos are those of the synced data; this device's documents and photos that the synced data does not have stay only in the backup.
replace.unsent: Moony sends the waiting changes first; anything it cannot send stays only in the backup.
replace.backupWhere: The backup is listed under Settings → Data and backups, under “Backups made before sync replaced data”.

outcome.attachments: Documents and photos only in the backup now: {{count}}
outcome.items: Changed items that were not sent, only in the backup: {{count}}
outcome.batches: Batches of changes that were not sent, only in the backup: {{count}}
outcome.someUnsent: Some changes stay only in the backup.
outcome.kept: The backup holds the only copy of what it contains, so Moony never deletes it. You can delete it under Settings → Data and backups, under “Backups made before sync replaced data”.

replace.backupWherePhone: The backup is listed under Settings → Backup and transfer.

saved.title: A backup was saved on this phone
saved.where: It is listed under Settings → Backup and transfer. Moony never deletes it; only you can.
saved.filesHint: Moony's data is left out of your phone's own backups. Save a copy to Files if you want to reach this backup outside Moony.

limits.lostTitle: Lost a device or the Recovery Kit?
limits.lostDevice: A lost device or Recovery Kit can't be cut off from your synced data yet, and anyone who has one can already read what it holds. If one goes missing, delete the synced data and set sync up again with a new Kit; your other devices will then need to join again.

codes.pairNotForSetup: This is a pairing code, not a connection code. Scan it when you add this device to sync that is already running.
codes.kitNotForSetup: This is a Recovery Kit code, not a connection code. Use it when you join synced data that already exists.
codes.connectionNotHere: This is a connection code for a sync server. Use it when you set up sync, not here.
codes.notAServerAddress: This is not a sync server address. Type the address of your sync server, or paste its connection code.

attachments.title: Documents and photos
attachments.onOtherDevices_one: {{count}} document or photo is on your other devices
attachments.onOtherDevices_other: {{count}} documents and photos are on your other devices

problem.noRoom: Documents and photos are waiting: the sync server has no room left. Ask whoever runs it for more space.
problem.serverNeedsUpdate: Documents and photos need a newer sync server. Everything else syncs.

whatSyncs.title: What syncs
whatSyncs.body: Everything you enter into Moony syncs. The language, look, menu, notifications, device password, recovery key and backups belong to each device. Prices and history are worked out on each device. Documents and photos sync too; a phone downloads one when you open it.

protection.line_one: Sync protects your data (last complete sync {{age}}, {{count}} device). Make a backup when you want to keep how things stood on a given day.
protection.line_other: Sync protects your data (last complete sync {{age}}, {{count}} devices). Make a backup when you want to keep how things stood on a given day.
